detail.title: GS270 2.1 RGB Gaming Speakers with Subwoofer - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS270 is a 2.1 channel stereo gaming speaker system built around a dedicated subwoofer and twin satellite speakers, delivering a rated 11W of clear, room-filling sound. Deep, punchy bass from the subwoofer pairs with crisp, distortion-free highs and mids from the satellites, making it equally suited to gaming, movies and music. Eye-catching RGB lighting wraps the subwoofer and satellites, adding a dynamic visual layer to any gaming desk. Setup is plug-and-play: connect any PC, laptop, tablet or phone through the 3.5mm AUX cable and power via USB, then fine-tune loudness instantly with the front-mounted metallic volume knob. Sturdy metallic mesh construction keeps the set durable through long gaming sessions.
